title_en: How beautiful and gorgeous she was

lines.cyr: Прошетав рано на утро, рано на утро,
lines.lat: Prošetav rano na utro, rano na utro,
lines.en: I strolled early in the morning, early in the morning,
I saw a beautiful maiden, beautiful maiden,

lines.cyr: Лудо на лепо говорит, лепо говорит:
lines.lat: Ludo na lepo govorit, lepo govorit:
lines.en: A lad spoke to the beauty, he said:
- Hey girl, young girl, you young girl,

lines.cyr: Тук' море отвори порти, отвори порти,
lines.lat: Tuk' more otvori porti, otvori porti,
lines.en: Instead open the doors, open the doors,

lines.cyr: тук' море отвори порти, отвори порти,
lines.lat: tuk' more otvori porti, otvori porti,
lines.en: instead open the doors, open the doors,
‘cause a tired young lad is coming.

lines.cyr: - Дегиди лудо и младо, лудо и младо,
lines.lat: - Degidi ludo i mlado, ludo i mlado,
lines.en: - Hey, you young lad, you young lad,

lines.cyr: ак' идет момче уморен, момче уморен,
lines.lat: ak' idet momče umoren, momče umoren,
lines.en: if a tired young lad is coming, a tired lad,

lines.cyr: јас немам што да му чинам.
lines.lat: jas nemam što da mu činam.
lines.en: I’ll have nothing to do with him.
How beautiful and gorgeous she was,
with a fine hat over her eyes,
with the gold coin on her forehead,
with fine pearls around her neck.
